# MobileFilmLab v0.2.0-beta.3 — readable settings & Pro sliders

**Primary target: Oppo Find X9 Ultra.** A photos-only Android camera, with natural Camera2 capture, optional creative looks and real RAW DNG where the camera exposes it.

## Readability

- Fixed black-on-dark inherited text in custom panels: the app supplies a light default content colour, and Settings uses a correctly scoped Material Surface.
- Brighter body/helper colours, larger settings labels and explanations, roomier selection rows and readable lens-matching gain values.
- Settings content scrolls independently; the title and Done action remain accessible, including at larger text sizes.

## Pro controls

- Tap EV / ISO / SEC / WB / FOCUS to open an editor, **not to cycle a value**. One editor is shown at a time to keep the viewfinder uncluttered.
- **EV slider** snaps to the selected Camera2 route's compensation steps and bounds. It explains why EV is inactive while ISO or shutter is manual.
- **ISO and shutter sliders** use logarithmic scales and the selected camera's limits, with explicit Auto/metered switches. Shutter also respects maximum frame duration and an app limit of 30 seconds; the capture deadline now accommodates long exposures.
- **White-balance slider** offers the existing approximate RGB-gain temperature control in 100 K increments, with Auto. This is not a calibrated sensor-temperature measurement.
- Autofocus modes remain discrete, directly selectable supported choices. Unsupported manual controls show a reason instead of silently cycling.
- Values are bounded again when changing camera routes. If one exposure axis is manual, the unspecified axis is metered then held: **not genuine ISO/shutter-priority auto exposure**.

## Preserved

Dynamic exact-ID rear cameras, JPEG / RAW / RAW+JPEG, untouched DNG sensor data, optional JPEG-only recipe processing, the complete recipe catalogue and existing custom presets/favourites are retained. No video or app-added AI enhancement is introduced.

Same package `com.mobilefilmlab.camera`, established signing certificate and higher **versionCode 12**. Install over beta.2 without uninstalling to preserve data. Debug builds remain separate.

## Validation and limitations

Automated checks cover slider interactions and capability gating, logarithmic mapping, EV quantisation, hardware/frame bounds, long-exposure deadlines, camera-switch state, dark-theme text contrast, large-font settings scrolling and actual native UI renders, alongside the existing regression suite. Release CI runs unit/native-graphics tests, release lint and signed APK identity/certificate/alignment checks.

No real handset is connected to this build environment. Actual per-lens slider response, long-exposure behaviour, firmware/manual support and sensor DNG validity still need device testing. UI renders use an explicitly labelled AI-generated demo scene and illustrative capabilities, not handset captures or image-quality evidence. The app is substantially AI-assisted in its development; it adds no generative/ML enhancement or cloud photo processing, but proprietary firmware/ISP processing remains opaque.

Owner-authorised regular Latest GitHub Release; the version remains beta-qualified. The previous binary downloads are withdrawn only after the replacement and website are verified; all source tags/history are retained. Already-downloaded or cached copies cannot be revoked.
